story.text: 이사한 지 얼마 안 된 집 안은 여전히 상자투성이였다. 선우는 팔을 걷어붙이고 제일 무거운 상자부터 옮겼다.
story.reading: i-sa-han ji eol-ma an doen jib an-eun yeo-jeon-hi sang-ja-tu-seong-i-eot-da. seon-u-neun pal-eul geod-eo-but-i-go je-il mu-geo-un sang-ja-bu-teo om-gyeot-da.
story.en: The inside of the house I'd just moved into was still full of boxes. Sunwoo rolled up his sleeves and started moving the heaviest box first.

story.text: "이 정도면 이사 도와준 값은 톡톡히 받아야겠다." 그가 이마의 땀을 닦으며 능청스레 말했다.
story.reading: "i jeong-do-myeon i-sa do-wa-jun gab-eun tok-tok-hi bad-a-ya-get-da." geu-ga i-ma-ui ttam-eul dakk-eu-myeo neung-cheong-seu-re mal-haet-da.
story.en: "At this rate I should get properly paid back for helping you move." He said, wiping sweat off his forehead, all casual about it.

story.text: "오늘 저녁에 조촐하게 집들이 하기로 했다며? 나도 낄 자격 충분하지?" 그가 넉살 좋게 물었다.
story.reading: "o-neul jeo-nyeog-e jo-chol-ha-ge jib-deul-i ha-gi-ro haet-da-myeo? na-do kkil ja-gyeok chung-bun-ha-ji?" geu-ga neok-sal jo-ke mul-eot-da.
story.en: "You're having a small housewarming tonight, right? I've definitely earned a spot at it, haven't I?" He asked, cheeky as ever.

story.text: 짐 정리를 마치고 나니, 어머니가 챙겨주신 떡이 눈에 들어왔다. "이웃들한테 먼저 돌리고 오자."
story.reading: jim jeong-ri-reul ma-chi-go na-ni, eo-meo-ni-ga chaeng-gyeo-ju-sin tteog-i nun-e deul-eo-wat-da. "i-ut-deul-han-te meon-jeo dol-li-go o-ja."
story.en: After finishing unpacking, I noticed the rice cake my mom had packed for me. "Let's go hand these out to the neighbors first."

story.text: 옆집, 위층, 아래층까지 돌며 떡을 답례품으로 건넸다. 선우는 넉살 좋게 먼저 인사를 건네며 분위기를 풀었다.
story.reading: yeop-jip, wi-cheung, a-rae-cheung-kka-ji dol-myeo tteog-eul dam-nye-pum-eu-ro geon-net-da. seon-u-neun neok-sal jo-ke meon-jeo in-sa-reul geon-ne-myeo bun-wi-gi-reul pul-eot-da.
story.en: We went around to the neighbor next door, upstairs, and downstairs, handing out rice cake as a little gift. Sunwoo broke the ice by greeting them first, cheerful as ever.

story.text: 저녁이 되자 작은 집들이가 시작됐다. "인테리어 나쁘지 않네. 다음엔 내가 좀 봐줄까?" 그가 벽을 톡톡 두드리며 웃었다.
story.reading: jeo-nyeog-i doe-ja jak-eun jib-deul-i-ga si-jak-doet-da. "in-te-ri-eo na-ppeu-ji anh-ne. da-eum-en nae-ga jom bwa-jul-kka?" geu-ga byeog-eul tok-tok du-deu-ri-myeo us-eot-da.
story.en: As evening fell, the small housewarming party began. "The interior's not bad. Want me to take a look next time?" He said, laughing as he tapped the wall.

story.text: "됐거든, 니 손재주 못 믿는다." 나는 웃으며 그의 어깨를 밀쳤다. 새 보금자리에 웃음소리가 가득 찼다.
story.reading: "dwaet-geo-deun, ni son-jae-ju mot mid-neun-da." na-neun us-eu-myeo geu-ui eo-kkae-reul mil-chyeot-da. sae bo-geum-ja-ri-e us-eum-so-ri-ga ga-deuk chat-da.
story.en: "No thanks, I don't trust your handiwork." I laughed and shoved his shoulder. Laughter filled my new little nest.

story.text: "오늘 단어랑 대화, 새집 정리하듯 차근차근 풀어봐라."
story.reading: "o-neul dan-eo-rang dae-hwa, sae-jip jeong-ri-ha-deut cha-geun-cha-geun pul-eo-bwa-ra."
story.en: "Go through today's words and conversation step by step, just like organizing a new home."

words.example_en: I'm moving to a new apartment next month.
We decided to have a housewarming party this weekend.

words.example: 새로 이사 온 이웃에게 인사를 건넸다.
words.example_reading: sae-ro i-sa on i-ut-e-ge in-sa-reul geon-net-da
words.example_en: I greeted the neighbor who had just moved in.
I prepared a token gift as a sign of thanks.
I decorated the new house's interior in a cute, cozy way.

sentences.en: I moved to a new apartment last week.
We decided to have a housewarming this weekend.

sentences.ko: 이웃에게 먼저 인사를 건네는 게 좋다.
sentences.reading: i-ut-e-ge meon-jeo in-sa-reul geon-ne-neun ge jo-ta
sentences.en: It's good to greet your neighbors first.
I handed out rice cake as a token gift to the house next door.

sentences.ko: 인테리어를 새로 하니 집 분위기가 확 달라졌다.
sentences.reading: in-te-ri-eo-reul sae-ro ha-ni jib bun-wi-gi-ga hwak dal-la-jyeot-da
sentences.en: Redoing the interior completely changed the atmosphere of the house.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이 상자, 뭐가 이래 무겁노. 책이가?
turns.reading: i sang-ja, mwo-ga i-rae mu-geop-no. chaeg-i-ga?
turns.en: This box, why's it so heavy. Is it books?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Yeah, mostly books. Carry it gently.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 알았다. 근데 오늘 저녁에 집들이 한다며? 나도 부르는 거제?
turns.reading: al-at-da. geun-de o-neul jeo-nyeog-e jib-deul-i han-da-myeo? na-do bu-reu-neun geo-je?
turns.en: Got it. But you're having a housewarming tonight, right? I'm invited too, aren't I?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Of course, you're the one who worked hardest.

dialogues.question: 선우가 짐을 옮기며 승객에게 확인한 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo confirm with the passenger while moving her things?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 무거운 상자를 옮기면서 오늘 저녁 집들이에 자신도 초대되는지 넌지시 물어봤습니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 떡 이거, 몇 집이나 돌릴 거고?
turns.reading: tteok i-geo, myeot jip-i-na dol-lil geo-go?
turns.en: This rice cake, how many houses are you planning to give it to?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: The place next door and above and below, about four households.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 내가 먼저 인사할게. 이런 건 내가 좀 하거든.
turns.reading: nae-ga meon-jeo in-sa-hal-ge. i-reon geon nae-ga jom ha-geo-deun.
turns.en: I'll go greet them first. I'm kind of good at this stuff.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 니 은근 넉살 좋은 거 오늘 또 느낀다.
turns.reading: ni eun-geun neok-sal jo-eun geo o-neul tto neu-kkin-da.
turns.en: I'm realizing again today just how surprisingly good you are with people.

dialogues.question: 선우와 승객이 떡을 돌리려는 집은 총 몇 곳인가요?
dialogues.question_en: How many households are Sunwoo and the passenger planning to hand rice cake to?
dialogues.explanation: 승객은 옆집과 위아래층까지 총 네 집에 떡을 돌릴 예정이라고 말했습니다.
